title: vJoilv
description: vJoilv lets server owners customize or disable join and leave messages on Paper and Folia servers with MiniMessage, legacy color codes, placeholders, and a reload command.
body:
[![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef01ad6b39a79dd292c4984e6b8a8c27b08d08c9.png)](https://discord.gg/5AWcWHBCPt)

## Description
vJoilv is a lightweight Paper and Folia plugin for customizing vanilla join and leave messages. It allows server owners to edit messages in the config, use MiniMessage formatting, legacy `&` color codes, placeholders, and reload the plugin without restarting the server.

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Custom join message | Change the message shown when a player joins |
| Custom leave message | Change the message shown when a player leaves |
| Disable messages | Completely hide join and/or leave messages |
| MiniMessage support | Use modern formatting like gradients, colors, hover text, and more |
| Legacy color support | Supports classic `&` color codes |
| Placeholders | Use values like player name, world, online players, and max players |
| Reload command | Reload the config without restarting the server |
| Folia support | Built to support Folia-compatible servers |

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/vjoivl reload` | Reloads the configuration file | `vjoivl.reload` |
| `/vjoivl relooad` | Reloads the configuration file | `vjoivl.reload` |
| `/vjoivl preview join` | Previews the join message | `vjoivl.preview` |
| `/vjoivl preview leave` | Previews the leave message | `vjoivl.preview` |

## Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description |
|---|---|
| `{player}` | Player name |
| `{displayname}` | Player display name |
| `{world}` | Player world |
| `{online}` | Online player count |
| `{max_players}` | Server max players |
| `{unique_players}` | Total known players |

## Compatibility

| Software | Version |
|---|---|
| Paper | 1.21+ |
| Folia | 1.21+ |
| Java | 21+ |
